description: TOPHEN crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C45 H52 Cl1 N7 Nd1 O9 Zn2 1+,3(H2 O1),Cl1 1-. From the CIF bond table, Zn1 (Zn) has 2 O neighbors; Zn2 (Zn) has 3 O neighbors; Nd1 (Nd) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.525-3.639 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 104.17-111.13°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C45H52N7O9Cl2Zn2Nd.
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review.
